jobs.description: Due diligence. Continuous monitoring. Background checks. – Intelligo Products Use Cases Industries Platform Insights User Login Request Demo Know the facts. Assess the risk. Intelligo automates public record research, delivering comprehensive profiles of individuals and companies at lower cost and faster turnaround time. Request Demo Make informed decisions with Intelligo Due diligence & continuous monitoring Automated Reports. Advantage Reports. Continuous Monitoring. Intelligo offers report scopes for the full cycle of risk-based due diligence. Explore Products Workflow optimization Intellig​​o’s comprehensive due diligence platform automates the research process, combining proprietary AI with human analysis to deliver accurate information at lower cost and turnaround time. Explore Platform Our Partners “In our business speed and accuracy are essential. Intelligo gives us thorough insights into an individual within hours of requesting the report.” - Head of Operational Due Diligence at Hamilton Lane On Our Blog How Investors Could Have Avoided A $2.7M Cherry-Picking Scheme A Connecticut-based investment advisor agreed to pay almost $3 million to settle fraud charges from the Securities and Exchange Commission in September. On September 14, the SEC announced that it had reached a... Read more Due Diligence Could Have Saved FinTech from Prashant Bhardwaj. Here’s How. Read more How Intelligo Would Have Picked Up On The Bernie Madoff Scandal 11 Months Before His Arrest Read more How to Read an Intelligo Report Read more FAQs What services does Intelligo provide? + Intelligo provides due diligence and background check reports based on publicly available information and data from premium sources. Our reports are designed to give you a comprehensive view of any red flags or risks associated with entities or individuals with whom you seek to partner, invest, or engage in a business relationship. Our services can be used to vet risks before you engage in a business relationship and to monitor ongoing relationships. What is covered in an Intelligo report? + We have a variety of reports that provide insights into the legal, regulatory, traditional media, social media, financial, and professional history profiles of entities and individuals. Our suite of automated reports are mainly compiled by our AI platform, which rules out false positives and focuses on information relevant to our clients’ needs. Our Advantage reports combine the time and cost savings provided by AI-guided research with a human analyst who is then able to go a level deeper to connect the dots and provide a more comprehensive review. How is Intelligo different from other providers? + Intelligo is the first platform to train AI’s ability to collect and analyze data with the mindset of a human due diligence researcher. Our technology has gone through years of training and has been given tens of thousands of points of feedback to learn from to provide relevant insights while reducing false positives for the user. The relevant algorithms continue to improve as they receive continuous feedback from our research and product teams. What is Intelligo’s pricing? + Our platform offers a variety of pricing options depending on your use case and need. Book a demo with a member of our solutions team to find out which service and pricing plan is right for you. Get started with a background check today.
